steps.cmd: set -eu; STATE=.ai-dev-nova-upgrade; mkdir -p "$STATE"; ORIG_BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD); printf '%s' "$ORIG_BRANCH" > "$STATE/orig-branch"; echo "[1/10] 已进入 react18 目录: $(pwd)"; echo "[1/10] 执行前分支: $ORIG_BRANCH"; case "$ORIG_BRANCH" in test|test-*|origin/test*) echo "[1/10] 提示: 当前在测试/预发分支，本流程只会修改远程最大 sprint 分支，不会改 $ORIG_BRANCH";; esac; git fetch

set -eu; STATE=.ai-dev-nova-upgrade; SPRINT_NUM=$(git branch -r | sed -nE 's#^[[:space:]]*origin/sprint-([0-9]+)$#\1#p' | sort -n | awk 'END{print}'); if [ -z "$SPRINT_NUM" ]; then echo "未找到远程 sprint 分支" >&2; exit 1; fi; SPRINT_BRANCH="sprint-$SPRINT_NUM"; printf '%s' "$SPRINT_NUM" > "$STATE/sprint-num"; printf '%s' "$SPRINT_BRANCH" > "$STATE/sprint-branch"; echo "[2/10] 目标 sprint 分支: $SPRINT_BRANCH（远程 origin/sprint-N 最大编号）"; git fetch origin "$SPRINT_BRANCH"; if git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/heads/$SPRINT_BRANCH"; then git checkout "$SPRINT_BRANCH"; else git checkout -b "$SPRINT_BRANCH" "origin/$SPRINT_BRANCH"; fi; git reset --hard "origin/$SPRINT_BRANCH"; echo "[2/10] 已切换到 $SPRINT_BRANCH 并同步 origin/$SPRINT_BRANCH @ $(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"

set -eu; STATE=.ai-dev-nova-upgrade; SPRINT_BRANCH=$(cat "$STATE/sprint-branch"); echo "[3/10] 拉取 $SPRINT_BRANCH 最新代码"; set +e; PULL_OUT=$(git pull --ff-only origin "$SPRINT_BRANCH" 2>&1); PULL_CODE=$?; set -e; echo "$PULL_OUT"; if [ $PULL_CODE -ne 0 ]; then echo "[3/10] git pull 失败 exit=$PULL_CODE" >&2; exit 1; fi; echo "[3/10] 拉取完成"

set -eu; STATE=.ai-dev-nova-upgrade; SPRINT_NUM=$(cat "$STATE/sprint-num"); VERSION=$(npm view @chanjet/nova-uikit versions --json 2>/dev/null | SPRINT_NUM="$SPRINT_NUM" node -e 'let raw=""; process.stdin.on("data", (chunk) => raw += chunk); process.stdin.on("end", () => { try { const parsed = JSON.parse(raw); const versions = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [parsed]; const sprint = process.env.SPRINT_NUM; const matched = versions.filter((v) => new RegExp("^1\\." + sprint + "\\.\\d+$").test(v)).sort((a, b) => Number(a.split(".")[2]) - Number(b.split(".")[2])); if (!matched.length) { console.error("未找到 1." + sprint + ".y 格式的 @chanjet/nova-uikit 版本"); process.exit(1); } process.stdout.write(matched[matched.length - 1]); } catch (e) { console.error(e.message); process.exit(1); } });'); printf '%s' "$VERSION" > "$STATE/version"; echo "[4/10] 命中的 nova 版本: $VERSION"

set -eu; STATE=.ai-dev-nova-upgrade; SPRINT_BRANCH=$(cat "$STATE/sprint-branch"); VERSION=$(cat "$STATE/version"); CURRENT=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD); if [ "$CURRENT" != "$SPRINT_BRANCH" ]; then echo "[5/10] 错误: 当前分支为 $CURRENT，预期 $SPRINT_BRANCH" >&2; exit 1; fi; echo "[5/10] 修改分支: $CURRENT"; VERSION="$VERSION" node -e 'const fs = require("fs"); const pkgPath = "package.json"; const pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(pkgPath, "utf8")); const sections = ["dependencies", "devDependencies", "peerDependencies", "optionalDependencies", "resolutions"]; const targets = ["@chanjet/nova-athena", "@chanjet/nova-cross-shared", "@chanjet/nova-intelligent-import", "@chanjet/nova-microkernel", "@chanjet/nova-shared", "@chanjet/nova-uikit", "@chanjet/nova-uikit-compat", "@chanjet/ai-runtime", "@chanjet/ai-adapters"]; const updated = []; const missing = []; for (const name of targets) { let found = false; for (const section of sections) { if (pkg[section] && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(pkg[section], name)) { pkg[section][name] = process.env.VERSION; found = true; updated.push(section + ":" + name); } } if (!found) missing.push(name); } if (missing.length) { console.warn("package.json 缺少依赖(已跳过): " + missing.join(", ")); } fs.writeFileSync(pkgPath, JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2) + "\n"); console.log("已更新依赖: " + updated.join(", "));'; echo "[5/10] package.json 已更新为 $VERSION"

set -eu; STATE=.ai-dev-nova-upgrade; SPRINT_BRANCH=$(cat "$STATE/sprint-branch"); VERSION=$(cat "$STATE/version"); CURRENT=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD); if [ "$CURRENT" != "$SPRINT_BRANCH" ]; then echo "[6/10] 错误: 当前分支为 $CURRENT，预期 $SPRINT_BRANCH，已中止避免写错分支" >&2; exit 1; fi; echo "[6/10] 提交分支: $CURRENT"; echo "[6/10] 当前变更:"; git status --short package.json; git add package.json; if git diff --cached --quiet; then echo "package.json 无需更新，未生成提交" >&2; exit 1; fi; git commit -m "ZJYF-121254:修改nova版本号为$VERSION"; echo "[6/10] 提交完成: ZJYF-121254:修改nova版本号为$VERSION"

set -eu; STATE=.ai-dev-nova-upgrade; SPRINT_BRANCH=$(cat "$STATE/sprint-branch"); CURRENT=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD); if [ "$CURRENT" != "$SPRINT_BRANCH" ]; then echo "[7/10] 错误: 当前分支为 $CURRENT，预期 $SPRINT_BRANCH，已中止避免推错分支" >&2; exit 1; fi; echo "[7/10] 推送 $CURRENT -> origin/$SPRINT_BRANCH"; git push -u origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$SPRINT_BRANCH"
set -eu; STATE=.ai-dev-nova-upgrade; ORIG_BRANCH=$(cat "$STATE/orig-branch"); echo "[8/10] 切回原分支: $ORIG_BRANCH"; git checkout "$ORIG_BRANCH"

set -eu; STATE=.ai-dev-nova-upgrade; VERSION=$(cat "$STATE/version"); SPRINT_BRANCH=$(cat "$STATE/sprint-branch"); ORIG_BRANCH=$(cat "$STATE/orig-branch"); echo "[9/10] 全部步骤执行成功"; echo "[9/10] nova 版本: $VERSION"; echo "[9/10] sprint 分支: $SPRINT_BRANCH"; echo "[9/10] 已切回原分支: $ORIG_BRANCH"

set -eu; STATE=.ai-dev-nova-upgrade; SPRINT_BRANCH=$(cat "$STATE/sprint-branch"); VERSION=$(cat "$STATE/version"); REPORT_JS="$AI_DEV_DESKTOP_ROOT/tools/nova-package-json-verify-report.cjs"; echo "[10/10] 拉取远程 origin/$SPRINT_BRANCH 以生成 Markdown 核对报告"; git fetch origin "$SPRINT_BRANCH" 2>&1; if ! git rev-parse --verify -q "refs/heads/$SPRINT_BRANCH^{commit}" >/dev/null; then echo "[10/10] 本地分支 $SPRINT_BRANCH 不存在" >&2; exit 1; fi; if ! git rev-parse --verify -q "origin/$SPRINT_BRANCH^{commit}" >/dev/null; then echo "[10/10] 远程分支 origin/$SPRINT_BRANCH 不存在" >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ ! -f "$REPORT_JS" ]; then echo "[10/10] 未找到报告脚本: $REPORT_JS" >&2; exit 1; fi; SPRINT_BRANCH="$SPRINT_BRANCH" VERSION="$VERSION" STATE="$STATE" node "$REPORT_JS"; rm -rf "$STATE"
